items.name: C22-098-Fruity-Website
items.description: 🍏 Capstone Project of MSIB Dicoding 2022 Cycle 3. We plan to build a machine learning model to predict fresh fruit. That way, users are expected to be able to easily separate between fresh and rotten fruit.

items.name: Food-Freshness-Detection-Using-Deep-Learning
items.description: This project classifies fruit quality into five levels (Fresh to Rotten) using image preprocessing, data augmentation, and clustering (K-Means, Agglomerative, DBSCAN). Deep learning models are trained on clustered data, with AlexNet + Agglomerative Clustering achieving top results (Acc: 0.84, F1: 0.83).

items.name: fruitQualityYoloModel
items.description: Contains model for ripe and rotten fruits.

items.name: Fresh-vs-Rotten-Fruit-Classification-YOLOv8-
items.description: Built a YOLOv8-based image classification system to identify fresh vs rotten fruits (Apple, Banana, Strawberry). The project includes dataset restructuring, train–validation splitting, model training, evaluation with confusion matrices, and high-confidence predictions on unseen images using transfer learning.

items.name: rotten_fruits_detector
items.description: Deep learning model for rotten fruit detection using CNN — Python + Jupyter + TensorFlow

items.name: Fruit-freshness-Detection-using-Machine-Learning
items.description: A ML-based project that classifies fruits as fresh or rotten using image inputs. Built with TensorFlow/Keras(CNN model) and trained on a dataset of fresh and rotten fruits, the model achieves over 95% accuracy by recognizing key visual patterns like color, texture, and surface changes.

items.name: Fruit-Ripeness-Prediction
items.description: Machine learning project to classify healthy and rotten fruits and vegetables using a convolutional neural network (CNN). The dataset consists of labeled images, and the model employs data augmentation and batch normalization for improved accuracy.

items.name: Fruit_Quality_Detection_Using_Deep_Learning
items.description: Our goal was simple but ambitious: build a system that automatically detects whether fruits are fresh or rotten using nothing more than a budget IoT camera and a cloud-hosted AI model.

items.name: Fruit-Quality-Detection-A-Comparative-Study-of-the-YOLO-Series
items.description: This project compares YOLOv8, YOLOv9, YOLOv10, and YOLOv11 models for automated fruit quality detection. Using computer vision, it classifies fruits into Fresh, Mild, and Rotten categories, evaluating each model's performance in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and speed.

items.name: Smart-Sorting-Transfer-Learning-for-Identifying-Rotten-Fruits-and-Vegetables
items.description: **Smart Sorting: Transfer Learning for Identifying Rotten Fruits and Vegetables** uses AI models trained on large datasets to detect spoilage in produce. It applies transfer learning to improve accuracy in sorting fruits and vegetables, reducing food waste and enhancing quality control.

items.name: AI_CNN_fruitIdentification
items.description: cnn model to classify fresh, rotten, and close to spoiling fruit

items.name: Classification-of-Fresh-and-rotten-fruits
items.description: This CNN model will classify the fruits ( Banana-orange-apple ) into fresh and rotten category.

items.name: fruit_sorter_project
items.description: web project that contains 5 models to classify 3 types of poaching into fresh or rotten

items.name: FRUIT_CLASSIFICATION_FRESH_VS_ROTTEN_USING-CONVOLUTIONAL-NEURAL_NETWORK
items.description: This project uses a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to classify images of fresh and rotten fruits. The model is trained on a dataset of labeled fruit images, leveraging deep learning techniques to accurately distinguish between fresh and spoiled produce.

items.name: Fruit-Vegetable-Quality-Analyzer
items.description: Fruit & Vegetable Quality Analyzer – An AI-powered web app that analyzes the freshness (fresh/rotten) and ripeness (ripe/unripe) of fruits and vegetables using deep learning models built with TensorFlow and Flask.

items.name: Fruit-ripeness-CNN
items.description: This repository contains a deep learning project focused on classifying fresh and rotten fruits using transfer learning, data augmentation, and fine-tuning techniques. The project utilizes a VGG16 base model pretrained on ImageNet and aims to achieve a validation accuracy of 92% or higher on a dataset comprising various fruit categories.

items.description: model 학습

items.name: Rotten-Fruit-Classification
items.description: Comparison of deep learning models (CNN, ResNet50, and MobileNetV3) for classifying rotten vs. fresh fruits. Includes model architecture details, dataset preprocessing, and performance metrics evaluation.

items.name: Rotten-Fruit-Detection-using-CNN-model
items.description: “Rotten apple detection using CNN" is the development of a machine learning model that can accurately detect rotten apples from a dataset of apple images using the CNN deep learning architecture

items.name: Fresh-RottenFruitClassifier
items.description: The model classifies the fresh fruits and rotten fruits from the input fruit images. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is used for extracting the features from input fruit images and to classify the images into fresh and rotten fruits.

items.name: Fresh-Rotten-Fruit-Identifier.
items.description: A model that is able to recognize fresh and rotten fruit using Deep Learning

items.name: fresh-rotten-fruit-classifier
items.description: Deep learning–based web app that classifies fruit images as Fresh or Rotten using a CNN model and a Streamlit interface.

items.name: Automated-fresh-fruit-sorting-system
items.description: the system consists of a Convolutional neural network model that classify the fruit and its condition eg rotten oranges or fresh apples. the model is then deployed using TensorFlow lite on raspberry pi which controls a servo that removes the rotten fruit

items.name: Fruit-Freshness-Classifier
items.description: A CNN and MobileNetV2 model classify fruit images (strawberries, peaches, pomegranates) as Fresh or Rotten, with a Streamlit app for real-time predictions.

items.name: CNN-model-for-fruit-and-veg-detection-
items.description: This project uses a CNN to classify images of fruits and vegetables, identifying fresh versus rotten produce. Built with TensorFlow and Keras, it aims to support quality control, reduce food waste, and enable consumer freshness checks through automated image recognition.

items.name: FruitRipenessClassificationProject
items.description: 🔹This project uses the CNN model to classify fruits as either fresh or rotten based on their images. It provides a solution for assessing fruit quality in agriculture, markets, and the food industry.

items.name: Fruit-Freshness-Prediction
items.description: In this project, I predicted whether fruit is rotten or not using sequential model, ResNet50v2 and VGG16, trained all of them using the Fruit fresh and rotten for classification Kaggle dataset. Got an accuracy of 96.96%, 97.41% and 91.4% respectively. Please see readme for details.

items.name: Smart-Sorting-Transfer-Learning-for-Identifying-Rotten-Fruits-and-Vegetables
items.description: Smart Sorting is an innovative project focused on enhancing the precision and efficiency of detecting rotten fruits and vegetables using cutting-edge transfer learning techniques. By leveraging pre-trained deep learning models and adapting them to specific datasets of fruits and vegetables.

items.name: Smart-Sorting-Transfer-Learning-for-Identifying-Rotten-Fruits-and-Vegetables
items.description: Smart Sorting is an innovative project focused on enhancing the precision and efficiency of detecting rotten fruits and vegetables using cutting-edge transfer learning techniques. By leveraging pre-trained deep learning models and adapting them to specific datasets of fruits and vegetables.

items.name: Sushma824-Smart-Sorting-Transfer-Learning-for-Identifying-Rotten-Fruits-and-Vegetables
items.description: **Smart Sorting** uses transfer learning to identify rotten fruits and vegetables through image classification. By leveraging pre-trained deep learning models, it enables fast and accurate detection, helping reduce food waste and improving quality control in markets, warehouses, and supply chains.
